content2.content: Flutter is fast by default, but poor coding practices can lead to jank. Optimization ensures a smooth 60fps experience.

content4.content: Using `const` allows Flutter to reuse widgets instead of rebuilding them. This is the single most effective optimization.

content6.content: For long lists, always use `ListView.builder` instead of `ListView` with a list of children. This ensures only visible items are built.

content8.content: Push state down the tree. Don't rebuild the entire page if only a small button needs to update.

content10.content: Profile your app on a real device in Profile mode, not Debug mode.
